name: Google LLC (Google DeepMind)
notes: Subsidiary of Alphabet Inc. (US). Gemma is authored by Google DeepMind.

name: Microsoft Corporation
notes: EU AI Act summaries for Phi are issued by Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited.

name: NVIDIA Corporation
notes: Not on the Code of Practice signatory list, but publishes an AI Act training-content summary for the Nemotron 3/3.5 family.

name: Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)
notes: Non-profit research institute.

name: Alibaba Cloud (Qwen team)
notes: Qwen is the model team of Alibaba Cloud, part of the listed Alibaba Group (NYSE/HKEX).

name: DeepSeek (Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.)
notes: Founded 2023 by Liang Wenfeng out of his quant hedge fund High-Flyer; press reports Liang holds a large majority after a 2026 round in which Tencent was the largest outside investor. EU authorised representative: Prighter.

name: Moonshot AI
notes: Private Beijing start-up. Investors include Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan (Long-Z) and, as reported lead of a July 2026 round, the state-backed National Artificial Intelligence Industry Investment Fund.

name: Z.ai (Zhipu AI; Z.AI Co., Ltd.)
notes: Tsinghua spin-off, listed in Hong Kong since 8 Jan 2026 (2513.HK); investors include Alibaba, Tencent, Ant Group and Saudi Aramco Prosperity7. On the US Entity List since Jan 2025 (press).

name: MiniMax (MiniMax Group Inc.)
notes: Shanghai-based, listed in Hong Kong since 9 Jan 2026 (0100.HK); Alibaba about 12.5-15% and Tencent about 2.8% per prospectus coverage. Its EU AI Act summary for M3 names Nanonoble Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) as provider, Prighter GmbH as EU representative.

name: Tencent (Hy / Hunyuan team)
notes: Listed in Hong Kong (0700.HK). Largest shareholder is Prosus (Naspers group, NL/ZA) with about 22.7-22.8%.

name: LG AI Research
notes: AI research arm of the LG Group; EXAONE licensor is LG Management Development Institute Co., Ltd. K-EXAONE developed under Korea's government Sovereign AI Foundation Model programme (government-provided GPUs).

name: Upstage
notes: Seoul-based AI company. Solar Open 2 built in the MSIT/NIPA Sovereign AI Foundation Model Project (GPU Track); clusters operated by Lablup.

name: NAVER Cloud / NAVER Corp.
notes: HyperCLOVA X SEED licensed jointly by NAVER Corp. (IP holder) and its affiliate NAVER Cloud Corp. (operator). Eliminated from Korea's sovereign AI project in Jan 2026 after reusing Qwen2.5 vision-encoder weights (press).

name: LLM-jp / National Institute of Informatics (NII)
notes: Public research institute; models developed by NII's Research and Development Center for Large Language Models (LLMC). Trained on AIST's ABCI 3.0.

name: Swallow LLM (Institute of Science Tokyo / AIST)
notes: Academic project of Institute of Science Tokyo (Okazaki and Yokota labs) with AIST; public funding (MEXT, NEDO, AIST); Hub org still named tokyotech-llm.

name: Preferred Networks (PFN)
notes: Tokyo-based private company. PLaMo 3 NICT base models co-developed with NICT (national research institute); flagship PLaMo 3.0 Prime is closed-weight. Chosen over Sakana AI, which has no current open-weight LLM flagship (only research checkpoints).

name: Sarvam AI
notes: Bengaluru-based startup; Sarvam 30B/105B trained on compute provided under the government IndiaAI Mission.

name: AI Singapore
notes: National AI programme funded by the National Research Foundation Singapore (and IMDA under the National LLM Funding Initiative); SEA-LION models adapt foreign bases.

name: Technology Innovation Institute (TII)
notes: Government research institute: part of Abu Dhabi Government's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC).

name: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) / Institute of Foundation Models (IFM)
notes: Public graduate AI university established by the Abu Dhabi government (2019). LLMs are released by its Institute of Foundation Models (IFM, founded May 2025); the former LLM360 Hub org now redirects to IFM. Jais 2 (inception42, G42/Inception with MBZUAI and Cerebras) is a separate line, not scored here.

name: AI21 Labs
notes: Privately held. Acquisition talks with Nvidia (Jan 2026) and Nebius (Apr 2026) ended without a deal; in May 2026 AI21 cut ~61% of staff and said it would halt development of the Jamba model family.

name: Cohere
notes: Privately held. Definitive business combination agreement with German Aleph Alpha signed 2026-09-16 (pending regulatory approval); Cohere is the acquiring party, combined company to operate as Cohere, dual HQ Toronto/Berlin. EU AI Act provider entity for Command A+ is Cohere Germany GmbH.
